name: Support control panel and CS dashboards
summary: Internal views for customer support and customer success: looking up customers and project progress, the CS capture dashboards (cards, tables, projects by company), status exports, and internal TechOps emails.

roles.note: Only the full projects-by-company list checks for a support user.

actions.action: View CS dashboard cards and tables
actions.note: Current behaviour; intended audience is Track3D staff

actions.action: View every project of a named company
Export structure-stage status with compliance tabs

nfr.statement: How stale the CS dashboard cards and tables may be when served from cache.
nfr.open_question: The cached view is refreshed in the background on each request. What maximum age is acceptable?

requirements.title: Support staff can look up a customer and their project progress
requirements.statement: The internal control panel lets support staff find a customer and see their information, and lets internal project managers track and update project progress. Missing customer data is flagged but doesn't block them.
requirements.rationale: PRD-only. No dedicated control-panel app was found; the nearest code is the support-only projects-by-company list.

acceptance_criteria.given: A support user in the control panel
acceptance_criteria.when: They search for a customer company
acceptance_criteria.then: The company's details and projects are shown, with any missing details flagged

requirements.title: Only support users export structure-stage status
requirements.statement: Support users can export the status of every structure and stage combination to Excel, optionally with the internal compliance report as extra tabs. Other users can't use the export.
requirements.rationale: PRD-only. No such export was found on the branches read.

requirements.title: CS dashboards summarise captures over the caller's projects
requirements.statement: Today the CS dashboard cards and tables (capture SLA by date for visual documentation and 2D progress, projects by company, captures by project, type and person) are built from a copy of each capture kept for the dashboard. They cover the caller's live projects across all companies. Listing every project of a named company is limited to support users.

requirements.title: Completed mobile upload groups email TechOps
requirements.statement: Today, when a mobile upload group completes, the TechOps mailbox is emailed. For one company, identified by a company ID written into the code, a second internal mailbox is added.
requirements.rationale: The per-company routing is code, not configuration (SRC-004 audit C1).

requirements.title: Progress tracking shows as Yes or No in internal dashboards
requirements.statement: The visual documentation dashboard and the Slack bot show, for each capture, whether progress tracking applies (Yes or No).
requirements.rationale: PRD-only for the display. The dashboard capture copy has a marked-for-progress field, but its use in the dashboard and bot was not checked.
